children: Motilal Oswal's research report on Bharat Forge

Bharat Forge (BHFC)’s 2QFY27 standalone adjusted PAT at INR3.8b came in line. Higher commodity and energy costs weighed on standalone margins. Consolidated PAT declined 7% YoY due to losses in the US subsidiaries and lower standalone margins. We now expect BHFC to post a CAGR of 16%/22%/36% in revenue/ EBITDA/PAT over FY26-28E. However, at current valuations of 58x FY27E and 39x FY28E earnings, most positives seem to be factored in. Reiterate Neutral with a TP of INR1,800 per share (valued at 40x FY28E EPS).
